name: battery_foil_demo
provenance: SYNTHETIC demonstration, not plant data, for EV battery cathode current-collector foil (1235-H18-like) with a final gauge of 16-18 um and intermediate gauges of 25-60 um. Foil mill: single-stand four-high, work roll 0.27 m diameter (230-330 mm reported, 260-280 typical [V S8]), backup roll 0.75 m (2.8 x the work roll; 2.4-2.8 x reported [V S8]), barrel 1.5 m, strip 1.2 m centred. Half-stack masses and stiffnesses are planner ESTIMATES scaled from the sheet demo mill [D]: work roll 1100 kg (steel barrel pi*0.135^2*1.5*7850 = 674 kg plus necks and chocks), backup roll 9000 kg (barrel 5200 kg plus necks and chocks), work/backup contact 2.0e10 N/m (shorter, smaller-diameter contact than the sheet mill 4e10), housing 6.0e9 N/m (lighter foil stand; sheet mill 1.4e10); 3 m free spans. Schedule 0.26 -> 0.135 -> 0.068 -> 0.035 -> 0.018 mm (48 %, 50 %, 49 %, 49 % per pass): the published battery-foil passes of 48-54 % [V S3, S4] go above the tool's 50 % reduction limit, so the schedule keeps each pass at or below 50 %. The pass 0.068 -> 0.035 mm is the case pass; the final pass 0.035 -> 0.018 mm (180 MPa, 38 / 42 MPa, 15 m/s) is listed so that the report shows what the tool cannot say about it: its exit gauge is below the 20 um floor of both roll-bite models, so its schedule and gauge-trend rows are not assessable (it may also be a doubled pass in practice, not modelled). 1235-H18-like supplied mean flow stress 150 / 165 / 175 MPa (stock UTS 150-200 MPa in H18 [V S4]; no hardening law), friction 0.03 on every pass, tensions 30-35 / 35-40 MPa (entry 29-49, exit 34-44 MPa reported [V S3]), exit speeds 8 / 11 / 13 m/s (600-1000 m/min reported [V S3, S4]), bite_model auto (Hitchcock solves P1 and P2; it rejects the case pass and the experimental mattress model solves it, 1.1 kN/mm of width, inside the 0.9-2.3 kN/mm reported [V S3, S4]). Oil 1.6 mPa s (1.8-2.1 mm2/s at about 0.8 kg/l [V S3, S4]), work-roll Rq 0.15 um (Ra 0.11-0.125 um [V S3, S4] x 1.25 [D]), strip Rq 0.2 um. Neat-oil spray header: 28 nozzles at 52 mm pitch, mean spray coefficient 2 kW/m2K (CHOSEN lower than the 3 kW/m2K emulsion value of the sheet demo [D]; thermal crown 5.0 um). PLANTED CAUSES: nozzle 11 (0.62 m) PARTLY blocked at flow level 0.45, and a 20 s closure of the zone valve of nozzles 18-19. Observations were GENERATED FROM THE MODEL ITSELF (cells 256, default thermal numerics): band positions = model steady stripe peak and event stripe peak rounded to 1 mm (0.623, 0.988 m); the model bands are LATENT under the 40 MPa mill tension and MANIFEST after tension release, so visible_only_after_tension_release is true and the appearance loose_or_buckle; intermittent duration = model visible time of the event band after tension release rounded to 10 s (150 s: at foil gauge the after-release threshold is about 0.2 um of stripe, so even a 20 s valve closure leaves a band for minutes); continuity both; positions repeat across coils and do not move after a work-roll change; the bands change with coolant zone switching; they do not change after roll wiper cleaning and do not track speed changes (a thermal stripe follows heat input slowly). worse_at_thinner_gauge is left NULL: on this mill the model gauge trend does NOT reproduce it (the onset heights rise toward the thin pass). The case therefore tests the screening logic at foil gauge, not the physics.
notes: Closed-loop demo: planted causes are a partly blocked nozzle (continuous band hidden under mill tension, visible after tension release, nozzle_thermal_stripe) and a cooling-zone valve closure (cooling_zone_switching_transient).
At 35 um the mill is in or near closed-gap rolling, which the tool does not model: see the foil-regime block. The lever table and the gauge-control section assume an open gap.

Phase-1 coolant section kept consistent with width_model.spray_header; its geometric screen can only represent a FULLY blocked nozzle, so nozzle 11 is listed as blocked there although width_model gives it flow level 0.45.

worse_at_lower_tension is left null although the model in-mill onset of the stripe falls with tension (6.5 um at 40 MPa, 1.5 um at 8 MPa): a band hidden under tension is also "worse at lower tension", so this observation does not separate foil tension lines from a latent thermal stripe.

Final pass 0.035 -> 0.018 mm (collector foil, plant final gauge 16-18 um): below the 20 um roll-bite floor; flag EXIT_GAUGE_BELOW_BITE_MODEL_FLOOR; its rows are reported as not assessable. Ask the plant whether this pass is single-sheet or doubled.
